title: Melanoma exosomes educate bone marrow progenitor cells toward a pro-metastatic phenotype through MET
central_claims: Melanoma exosomes transfer MET-mediated signals and educate bone marrow progenitors to promote metastatic niche formation; reducing exosomal MET diminishes metastasis.

source_manifest.title: Replication study: Melanoma exosomes educate bone marrow progenitor cells toward a pro-metastatic phenotype through MET.
source_manifest.finding: MET knockdown and exosomal MET were confirmed, but lung/bone metastasis differences were small and nonsignificant; protocol and knockdown differed.

source_manifest.title: Different growth and metastatic phenotypes associated with a cell-intrinsic change of Met in metastatic melanoma.
source_manifest.finding: Met-containing exosomes from Met-high melanoma increased lung metastasis by Met-low cells.

source_manifest.title: Pre-metastatic cancer exosomes induce immune surveillance by patrolling monocytes at the metastatic niche.
source_manifest.finding: Poorly metastatic melanoma exosomes instead stimulated immune surveillance; contrasted metastatic exosomes and extended the niche mechanism.
